parameters.description: The user's search query term. Query can not be empty. Maximum of 600 characters and 75 words in the query.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: The search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: The search language preference. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.
parameters.name: search_lang

parameters.description: The maximum number of search results considered to select the LLM context data. The default is 20 and the maximum is 50.
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Filters results for adult content. The following values are supported: - **off** - No filtering is done. - **moderate** - Drops adult content from the results used for context. - **strict** - Drops all adult content from the results used for context. When not set, no filtering is applied ; except for local recall, which stays `strict`.
parameters.name: safesearch

parameters.description: Whether to enable spellcheck on the query.
parameters.name: spellcheck

parameters.description: Whether to apply search operators.
parameters.name: operators

parameters.description: Whether to fall back to the original results when search operators return no results.
parameters.name: operators_fallback

parameters.description: Maximum number of different URLs to include in LLM context.
parameters.name: maximum_number_of_urls

parameters.description: Approximate maximum number of tokens to include in context. The default is `8192` and maximum is `32768`.
parameters.name: maximum_number_of_tokens

parameters.description: Maximum number of different snippets (or chunks of text) to include in LLM context. The default is `50` and maximum is `256`.
parameters.name: maximum_number_of_snippets

parameters.description: The mode to use to determine the threshold for including content in context.
parameters.name: context_threshold_mode

parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens to include per URL. The default is `4096` and maximum is `8192`.
parameters.display_name: Maximum number of tokens per url
parameters.name: maximum_number_of_tokens_per_url

parameters.display_name: Maximum number of snippets per url
parameters.name: maximum_number_of_snippets_per_url

parameters.description: Goggles act as a custom re-ranking on top of Brave's search index. The parameter supports both a url where the Goggle is hosted or the definition of the Goggle. For more details, see the [Goggles documentation](/documentation/resources/goggles). The parameter can be a single Goggle or a list of up to 3 Goggles.
parameters.name: goggles

parameters.description: Filters search results by page age. The age of a page is determined by the most relevant date reported by the content, such as its published or last modified date. The following values are supported: - **pd** - Pages aged 24 hours or less. - **pw** - Pages aged 7 days or less. - **pm** - Pages aged 31 days or less. - **py** - Pages aged 365 days or less. - **YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD** - A custom date range is also supported by specifying start and end dates e.g. `2022-04-01to2022-07-30`.
parameters.name: freshness

parameters.description: Whether to enable local recall. Not setting this value means auto-detect: local recall is used if a location is provided (`X-Loc-Lat` with `X-Loc-Long`, or `X-Loc-City`).
parameters.name: enable_local

parameters.description: Enable source metadata enrichment (site_name, favicon, thumbnail, description, fetched_content_timestamp) in the sources attribute of the response.
parameters.name: enable_source_metadata

parameters.description: First date for a custom freshness range; also choose an end date.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last date for a custom freshness range.
parameters.name: end_date

grounding.description: Container for all LLM context content by type.

sources.description: Metadata for all referenced URLs, keyed by URL.
